definitions.equation:
fb_abi_initial_fields (a:abi_omitted_state) <=>
    read ABI_X87_CW a = word 0x37f /\
    read ABI_X87_SW a = word 0 /\
    read ABI_X87_TAG a = word 0xffff /\
    read ABI_X87_FOP a = word 0 /\
    read ABI_X87_IP a = word 0 /\
    read ABI_X87_CS a = word 0 /\
    read ABI_X87_DP a = word 0 /\
    read ABI_X87_DS a = word 0 /\
    (!r:(3)word. read ABI_X87_REGS a r = word 0) /\
    read ABI_MXCSR a = word 0x1f80 /\
    read ABI_FS_SELECTOR a = word 0 /\
    read ABI_FS_BASE a = word 0x500000 /\
    read ABI_GS_SELECTOR a = word 0 /\
    read ABI_GS_BASE a = word 0
definitions.name: fb_abi_initial_fields

definitions.equation:
fb_file_code (file_bytes:num->byte) <=>
    !i. i<95 ==> file_bytes(0x241840+i) = EL i crypto_memcmp_mc
definitions.name: fb_file_code

definitions.equation:
fb_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding (image:int64->byte) <=>
    !a. lw_image_domain (val(a:int64))
        ==> image a = fb_reference_image file_bytes initial_rw padding a
definitions.name: fb_full_image

definitions.equation:
fb_machine image p q n different =
    (lw_state image p q n different,fb_initial_abi)
definitions.name: fb_machine

definitions.equation: fb_ordinary p q n a <=> lw_ordinary p q n a \/ fb_tls_page a
definitions.name: fb_ordinary

definitions.equation:
fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image p q n different <=>
    fb_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding
      (read memory (FST(fb_machine image p q n different))) /\
    bp_e2_crypto_pre 0x10241840 (word 0x300008) (word 0x400000)
      p q n (lw_memory image p q n different) (fb_read p q n) lw_execute
      (fb_ordinary p q n) (FST(fb_machine image p q n different)) /\
    fb_abi_initial_fields (SND(fb_machine image p q n different)) /\
    (!a. fb_tls_page a ==> fb_read p q n a /\ fb_ordinary p q n a) /\
    assurance_canonical48 (val(read ABI_FS_BASE
      (SND(fb_machine image p q n different))))
definitions.name: fb_pre

definitions.equation: fb_read p q n a <=> lw_read p q n a \/ fb_tls_page a
definitions.name: fb_read

definitions.equation:
fb_reference_image (file_bytes:num->byte) (initial_rw:int64->byte)
                     (padding:int64->byte) (a:int64) =
    if fb_immutable (val a) then file_bytes (val a-0x10000000)
    else if fb_initialized_rw (val a) then initial_rw a
    else padding a
definitions.name: fb_reference_image

theorems.name: FB_CODE_CORRESPONDENCE
theorems.statement:
!file_bytes initial_rw padding image.
    fb_file_code file_bytes /\ fb_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding image
    ==> lw_reference_code image

theorems.name: FB_EMPTY_FAMILY
theorems.statement:
!file_bytes initial_rw padding image p q.
    fb_file_code file_bytes /\ fb_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding image
    ==> fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image p q 0 F

theorems.name: FB_EQUAL_MISALIGNED_FAMILY
theorems.statement:
!file_bytes initial_rw padding image.
    fb_file_code file_bytes /\ fb_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding image
    ==> fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image
          (word 0x200001) (word 0x200041) 17 F /\
        (!i. i<17 ==>
          lw_memory image (word 0x200001) (word 0x200041) 17 F
             (word_add (word 0x200001) (word i)) = word 128 /\
          lw_memory image (word 0x200001) (word 0x200041) 17 F
             (word_add (word 0x200041) (word i)) = word 128)

theorems.name: FB_FASTPATH_FAMILY
theorems.statement:
!file_bytes initial_rw padding image.
    fb_file_code file_bytes /\ fb_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding image
    ==> fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image
          (word 0x200007) (word 0x200087) 16 F

theorems.name: FB_FULL_IMAGE_EXISTS
theorems.statement:
!file_bytes initial_rw padding.
    fb_file_code file_bytes
    ==> ?image. fb_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding image /\
                lw_reference_code image

theorems.name: FB_IDENTICAL_FAMILY
theorems.statement:
!file_bytes initial_rw padding image.
    fb_file_code file_bytes /\ fb_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding image
    ==> fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image
          (word 0x200003) (word 0x200003) 33 F

theorems.name: FB_IMAGE_PRESERVATION
theorems.statement:
!file_bytes initial_rw padding image p q n different.
    fb_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding image /\ lw_layout p q n
    ==> fb_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding
          (lw_memory image p q n different)

theorems.name: FB_LOW_CANONICAL_EDGE_FAMILY
theorems.statement:
!file_bytes initial_rw padding image.
    fb_file_code file_bytes /\ fb_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding image
    ==> fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image
          (word (2 EXP 47-1)) (word 0x200001) 1 F

theorems.name: FB_MACHINE_WITNESS_EXISTS
theorems.statement:
!file_bytes initial_rw padding.
    fb_file_code file_bytes
    ==> ?image.
      fb_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding image /\
      (!p q. fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image p q 0 F) /\
      fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image
        (word 0x200001) (word 0x200041) 17 F /\
      fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image
        (word 0x200001) (word 0x200041) 17 T /\
      fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image
        (word 0x200003) (word 0x200003) 33 F /\
      fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image
        (word 0x200001) (word 0x200002) 17 F /\
      fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image
        (word 0x200007) (word 0x200087) 16 F /\
      fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image
        (word (2 EXP 47-1)) (word 0x200001) 1 F /\
      fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image
        (word (2 EXP 64-1)) (word 0x200001) 1 F /\
      fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image
        (word 0x200fff) (word 0x210003) 17 F

theorems.name: FB_OVERLAP_FAMILY
theorems.statement:
!file_bytes initial_rw padding image.
    fb_file_code file_bytes /\ fb_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding image
    ==> fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image
          (word 0x200001) (word 0x200002) 17 F

theorems.name: FB_USER_PAGE_BOUNDARY_FAMILY
theorems.statement:
!file_bytes initial_rw padding image.
    fb_file_code file_bytes /\ fb_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding image
    ==> fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image
          (word 0x200fff) (word 0x210003) 17 F

theorems.name: FB_PRE_LIFT
theorems.statement:
!file_bytes initial_rw padding image p q n different.
    fb_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding image /\ lw_layout p q n /\
    lw_pre image p q n different
    ==> fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image p q n different

theorems.name: FB_REFERENCE_SATISFIES
theorems.statement:
!file_bytes initial_rw padding.
    fb_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding
      (fb_reference_image file_bytes initial_rw padding)

theorems.name: FB_TOP_EDGE_FAMILY
theorems.statement:
!file_bytes initial_rw padding image.
    fb_file_code file_bytes /\ fb_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding image
    ==> fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image
          (word (2 EXP 64-1)) (word 0x200001) 1 F

theorems.name: FB_UNEQUAL_FAMILY
theorems.statement:
!file_bytes initial_rw padding image.
    fb_file_code file_bytes /\ fb_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding image
    ==> fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image
          (word 0x200001) (word 0x200041) 17 T /\
        lw_memory image (word 0x200001) (word 0x200041) 17 T
          (word 0x200001) = word 128 /\
        lw_memory image (word 0x200001) (word 0x200041) 17 T
          (word 0x200041) = word 255

theorems.name: FB_VALID_ABI
theorems.statement:
fb_abi_initial_fields fb_initial_abi /\
    assurance_canonical48 (val(read ABI_FS_BASE fb_initial_abi)) /\
    fb_tls_page (val(read ABI_FS_BASE fb_initial_abi))
